scopeBasis.macos: Foliole 0.7.13 adds shared desktop editor gestures, immersive reading improvements, image resizing, formatting shortcuts, and Readwise repair behavior, so the macOS package is required.
scopeBasis.windows: Foliole 0.7.13 adds the same shared Electron editor and Readwise improvements to the supported Windows desktop app, so the Windows package and direct installer are required.
scopeBasis.linux: Foliole 0.7.13 adds the same shared Electron editor and Readwise improvements to Linux Experimental, so the Linux Experimental package is required.
